author: meghsat

evidence.api_compatibility: The pin bump introduces breaking changes (documented in PR): `max_tokens` exactness shifts token counts; streamed `usage` is now opt-in; stricter 400 responses for previously-ignored invalid fields. These affect FLM clients. The new `/v1/systemone` and `/v1/classify` endpoints on the `flm` backend are new, not breaking. The `systemone` route description and OpenAPI spec were updated. The `classify` route doc was updated to mention FLM decision models.
evidence.documentation: The PR updates in-code API descriptions for `/v1/systemone` and `/v1/classify`, and the OpenAPI spec in `docs/api/openai.md`. However, iswaryaalex flagged that the release notes need to capture the 1.0.7→1.0.11 breaking changes (max_tokens exactness, opt-in streaming usage, stricter validation), the `/v1/classify` example omits `truncated` despite the field being set, and the d3 models table lists five models but only `lite` is wired for this release.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The flm pin bump from v1.0.7 to v1.0.11 changes several behaviors visible to existing FLM users: `max_tokens` now returns exactly N tokens instead of N+1; streamed `usage` requires `stream_options.include_usage` to appear, and without it lemond's `/api/v1/stats` records no token counts or TPS for FLM streams; stricter request validation returns 400 for invalid `tool_choice`, forced tool calls on Qwen3 up to 1.7B and Qwen3.5 0.8B, conversation history to `*-flash` models, and requests with no `messages` or `prompt`. These are user-visible behavior changes not confirmed by CI alone. The new `/v1/systemone` and `/v1/classify` paths on FLM (NPU) are user-reachable endpoints that CI did not exercise.
evidence.post_approval_commits: All non-merge commits date to 2026-10-28 (last: `pr feedback: added max-length and 3 flag truncate flags`). No commits were added after the latest human approvals (fl0rianr on 2026-11-04, iswaryaalex on 2026-11-04). The branch was stable for review.
evidence.review: fl0rianr provided substantive review on 2026-11-01 identifying three specific issues (ctx_size forwarding, long-input error codes, truncation reporting). All three were addressed in the PR. fl0rianr approved twice (2026-11-01 and 2026-11-04). iswaryaalex provided hands-on NPU testing on XDNA2 with real classification results and flagged additional concerns: only d3-lite-FLM is wired (not turbo/ultra at 16.6 GB), /v1/classify omits `truncated` in the example body while code sets it, `model` conditionally set but schema marks it required, and `context_length_refusal` deep-copies the full response per request. No Co-authored-by trailer found.
evidence.security: No security concerns detected. The new `systemone_classify.cpp` is a pure classification helper. No credential handling, network calls beyond the existing backend API, or permission changes. The `ctx_size` stripping prevents an unexpected 422 from FLM — a minor robustness fix.
evidence.tests: New unit test file `test/cpp/test_flm_model_labels.cpp` covering checkpoint-based mode classification. Updated `test/cpp/test_llamacpp_systemone.cpp` to test shared `systemone::` functions plus FLM context-length refusal and truncated marking. Updated `test/cpp/test_backend_mode_contract.cpp` with `flm + classification`, `flm + classification + systemone`, and `flm + systemone` contract entries. Added `test_514_classify_text_longer_than_window` and `test_515_ctx_size_is_not_forwarded` to `test/server_systemone.py`. Updated `test/server_whisper.py` to reflect new error naming. Updated `test/utils/capabilities.py` with FLM d3 model entries on npu backend. All CI checks passed (Launchpad PPA, Snap Release).

maintainer_todos.text: Install d3-lite-FLM on NPU hardware (`lemonade backends install flm:npu`, `lemonade pull d3-lite-FLM`), send a /v1/systemone request with choice, noul, and score questions, and confirm every answer contains `truncated: false`.
Send a /v1/classify request with an input exceeding ~37,000 tokens and confirm the response is 400 with code `context_length_exceeded`.
Stream a /v1/chat/completions request to an FLM chat model with and without `stream_options.include_usage: true`, and confirm token counts appear in /api/v1/stats only when include_usage is set.
Send a request with `max_tokens: 100` to an FLM model and verify it returns exactly 100 tokens (not 101), matching the documented breaking change.
Send an invalid tool_choice to an FLM model and confirm it returns 400 instead of ignoring the field as it did under v1.0.7.
Update release notes for the v1.0.7→v1.0.11 pin bump to capture max_tokens exactness, opt-in streaming usage, and stricter request validation.
In the d3 models table, note which model(s) were actually tested on NPU hardware and which (turbo, ultra at 16.6 GB) were not wired for this release.

shout_outs.reason: Performed hands-on NPU validation on XDNA2 hardware: verified d3-lite-FLM loads, tested both /v1/systemone and /v1/classify endpoints, and benchmarked real PII classification scores (SSN 0.979, phone number 0.398), surfacing usability gaps that informed follow-up design.

subject: feat(backend): FLM 1.0.11 decision models support (#4037)
summary: Adds FastFlowLM 1.0.11 d3 decision model support on the NPU, wiring `flm serve --decision` to `POST /v1/systemone`, `POST /v1/classify`, and the router's `systemone`/`zero_shot` classifiers, while bumping the flm pin from v1.0.7 to v1.0.11.
verdict_reason: The flm pin bump from v1.0.7 to v1.0.11 introduces multiple breaking changes (max_tokens now exact, streamed usage opt-in, stricter request validation) that must be verified before shipping, and the release notes need to be updated with the model behavior details and which d3 models were actually run.
